title: Student loan payment benefits
summary: This document explains that eligible student loan payments made from your account earn 1.25% cashback, credited after the payment clears and is identified as a qualifying student loan payment to an eligible servicer. It defines qualifying direct payments, notes typical non-qualifiers (personal/individual transfers and reimbursements), and states EveryonePay has a $1,000 daily limit and typically does not qualify for cashback.
faqs: What payment types qualify for 1.25% student loan payment cashback?
Are electronic payments or mailed checks to a recognized loan servicer eligible?
What payments do not qualify for cashback (e.g., transfers to individuals or reimbursements)?
Does EveryonePay qualify for the student loan payment benefit, and what is the $1,000 daily limit?
When is the cashback reward posted after I make a qualifying payment?
